obligation: G007 - deep bounded search over MATERIALLY DIFFERENT classes
new_class: OUTLIER_SPLIT: sparse full-precision side-channel (top-|w| 0.5%) + coarse-group 2-bit affine base at group 128. NOT a quantization knob: a hybrid sparse+dense representation whose cost is (2 + 32/128) bits/weight base + 32 bits per retained outlier.
RESULT_1_new_class_dominates_best_affine: outlier-g128 (2.5419 EBPW, ppl 3.3579, median 4-gram 0.5066) beats affine-g64 (2.6251, 3.5220, 0.6398) on BYTES, PERPLEXITY and GENERATION simultaneously. First representation in this campaign to Pareto-dominate the pure-quantization frontier.
RESULT_2_negative_control_is_clean: random-g128 retains the SAME number of weights at full precision (0.005000 vs 0.004849) for the same bytes (2.5461 vs 2.5419) and gives ppl 4.0707 vs 3.3579 and median 4-gram 0.7527 vs 0.5066. The byte budget alone explains nothing; MAGNITUDE selection is doing the work.
RESULT_3_the_catastrophic_collapse_is_no: base-g128 emits 87 consecutive identical tokens. BOTH outlier and random selection remove that failure (worst max_run 2 and 1). So restoring any 0.5% of weights to full precision cures the degenerate repetition, while only MAGNITUDE selection improves perplexity. Two distinct effects.
CORRECTION_TO_G010: G010's coherence verdicts were computed from ONE generation per config. At n=8 with a bf16 reference they do not hold. affine-g64 was recorded as COHERENT on a single prompt scoring 4-gram 0.000; its MEDIAN over 8 prompts is 0.6398 against bf16's 0.0538 - 11.9x the reference repetition rate. NO configuration tested at or below 2.6251 EBPW retains bf16-comparable generation. The G010 bound is TIGHTER than reported, not looser. The catastrophic verdicts (max_run 87, ppl 44034) are unaffected; the COHERENT label was the overstatement.
STILL_OPEN: 2.5419 EBPW is far from the <=1.0 target and generation is ~9.4x the bf16 repetition rate. OUTLIER_SPLIT is a better frontier, not a solution. TPS is NOT measured for this class: the arms execute as dense bf16 after reconstruction, so bytes and capability are exact but the sparse channel has no kernel. Any TPS claim for it would be fabrication.
CAVEATS: 8 prompts, greedy decoding, 96 tokens each. Medians reported; per-prompt spread is wide.
Outlier indices costed at 16 bits each (a real packed format could do better, which would only improve this class's position).
ppl is the same fixed 512-token passage as the other receipts - comparable across arms, not a benchmark.
